Alex: quick post-call notes for NorthShore onboarding — a handful of product asks and a potential renewal flag. pasted raw below.
Priya: drop the top 3 asks so eng can triage quickly?
Alex: TL;DR top 3: 1) embeddings/search returning product display names but missing canonical SKUs 2) billing docs ambiguous about 'per-route' vs global quota 3) request: team-level quotas + admin UI + audit logs. also their onboarding script hit an SDK param mismatch (`route` -> `path`).
Devin: can we get a minimal repro for #1 (query + response)? even a single example helps.
Alex: pasted snippet & transcript link: https://app.redwood/meetings/northshore-2026-06-21/transcript 
Alex: ```
query: "lookup sku for model X-200"
response: "Model X-200 by NovoParts"   // expected: contains SKU token like SKU-X200-19
```
Rae: marking as renewal-risk. CSM said they're evaluating quarterly and search accuracy is a gating metric for expansion. adding label.
Priya: assigning owners — @Devin can you reproduce today? estimate whether it's prompt/preproc vs model mismatch.
Devin: will repro. if it's preproc/prompt we can patch in ~3 business days; model tuning/variant may be 2+ weeks. will post findings.
Alex: small docs/API fix (change example param `route` -> `path`) we can push ASAP.
Priya: action items: 1) Devin triage embeddings (owner: Devin) 2) Docs example update canary (owner: Priya) 3) Feature request: team quotas + admin UI + audit logs (owner: Alex).
Alex: created FEED-9333 and attached call notes: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-9333 — please add labels `onboarding`, `search`, `billing` and estimates.
feedback-bot: FEED-9333 created and linked to customer NorthShore. Priority: P2.
Rae: I'll follow up with the CSM to give a short interim workaround (prompt hint to include SKU or postprocess regex) and confirm acceptance criteria for reliability.
Priya: aim for triage update by EOD tomorrow and docs canary today.
Devin: updating FEED-9333 with repro steps now; will paste logs here after tests.
Alex: thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll schedule a 10m sync with NorthShore CSM if we have actionable next steps after Devin's repro.
